title: Ratio tiles with no clocked hours show a grey dash, not 0.00%
pre_body:
Preconditions

  1. User: you are signed in as a user whose role has the Reports permission (for example Admin).
  2. Browser: you use a desktop browser window at least 1024 pixels wide (a maximised laptop or desktop window).
  3. Location: you are in a location (workplace) with no clocked time at all and nothing else in it yet (for example ZZAUTOTEST No Clock Shop).
